name: faceless-studio
description: Three AI-run faceless channels (football tactics, GTA 6 news, multiverse recasts) built with Remotion

scripts.render:football: remotion render src/index.ts TacticsReel out/tactics.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts TacticsReelFeed out/tactics-feed.mp4
scripts.render:gta: remotion render src/index.ts GtaCountdown out/gta.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts GtaCountdownFeed out/gta-feed.mp4
scripts.render:recast: remotion render src/index.ts RecastReel out/recast.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts RecastReelFeed out/recast-feed.mp4
scripts.stills: remotion still src/index.ts TacticsReel out/still-football.png --frame=360 && remotion still src/index.ts GtaCountdown out/still-gta.png --frame=480 && remotion still src/index.ts RecastReel out/still-recast.png --frame=60
